how_to_use: Feed photos/<name>.png to the JS bean finder + model. These PNGs are the PIL-BILINEAR downscale of the source photo to <= 1200 px (the bean finder's own first step), so the bean finder's scale is 1.0 and results must match box-for-box. 'from_source_jpeg' shows the same pipeline run on the original JPEG in Python; it must be identical.
